label: microredis on-device engine (no network)
board: ESP32-D0WD-V3 rev3.1, 4MB flash, no PSRAM, 240 MHz
firmware: MicroPython v1.29.0 ESP32_GENERIC, microredis 8bde79f precompiled to .mpy (-O1)
workload: 16 B keys key:%012d, 32 B values, 500 keys
notes: MemoryError at <2000 keys during throughput phase (dict resize needs 13 KB contiguous; fragmentation)
sequential keys hash into only 230/1024 low-bit buckets; GET 6962/s sequential vs 66471/s random hex keys
bytes_per_key from gc.mem_alloc delta (47) is unreliable on the split heap; use max_keys
full server import costs 107 KB of heap; 39.5 KB free after MicroRedisServer() before WiFi
upstream needs 3 patches + bisect from micropython-lib to run on MicroPython at all (see tools/build_mpy.py)
